overview_description.description:
Onyx Security provides cybersecurity software that monitors and manages risks in artificial intelligence and machine learning systems. The platform evaluates AI models, data pipelines, and integrated tools to detect vulnerabilities, unsafe outputs, and potential misuse within AI-driven environments. Its technology examines how models interact with external data sources, prompts, and connected systems to identify security gaps that may affect reliability or compliance.

The platform includes tools for AI risk assessment, model monitoring, and security policy enforcement across development and deployment workflows. These tools analyze prompts, responses, and system interactions to detect abnormal behavior, data exposure, or manipulation attempts.
